description: Estimate what a buyer pays to import a parcel: goods + shipping + customs duty + import VAT/GST, for US, UK, EU (27 states), Japan, Korea, China, Australia, Canada and Singapore. Applies current de minimis rules (EU €3 duty on ≤€150 parcels from Jul 2026, US de minimis suspended, UK ≤£135, Japan ¥10,000, Korea $150/$200, AU A$1,000…) and says what is collected at checkout. Duty rates depend on the product's HS code — pass dutyRate when known.

date.description: Import date for dated rules (default today)

destination.description: Destination country ISO2: US, GB, DE, FR, JP, KR, CN, AU, CA, SG, any EU member

dutyRate.description: Product duty rate as a decimal (0.08 = 8%) incl. any extra tariffs. Omit if unknown.

fxRate.description: Units of destination currency per 1 unit of currency (skip live FX)

itemCategories.description: Number of distinct product types in the parcel (EU flat duty is per category)

origin.description: Origin country ISO2 (matters for Canada CUSMA, Korea US threshold)

name: landed_cost
